=== Procedure: Produccion.vwAnaliticaBobinaGetFilterData ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_BOBINANOSERIE'
		Do 'LoadBobinaNoSerieOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_EXTRUSIONEXTRUSORANOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadExtrusionExtrusoraNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_EXTRUSIONTURNONOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadExtrusionTurnoNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_EXTRUSIONOPERADORNOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadExtrusionOperadorNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_BOBINAOBSERVACIONES'
		Do 'LoadBobinaObservacionesOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_BOBINARECHAZADAOBSERVACIONES'
		Do 'LoadBobinaRechazadaObservacionesOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_BOBINASILOMOLIDONOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadBobinaSiloMolidoNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_BOBINASILOVIRGENNOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadBobinaSiloVirgenNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_BOBINALOTEVIRGEN'
		Do 'LoadBobinaLoteVirgenOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_EXTRUSIONLOTEPAQUETEADITIVOS'
		Do 'LoadExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivosOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_BOBINAPRODUCTONOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadBobinaProductoNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_BOBINAPRENSADOPRENSANOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadBobinaPrensadoPrensaNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_BOBINAINTERRUPCIONESMOTIVO'
		Do 'LoadBobinaInterrupcionesMotivoOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_BOBINADOWNTIMECODE'
		Do 'LoadBobinaDownTimeCodeOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_BOBINADOWNTIMEDESCRIPTION'
		Do 'LoadBobinaDownTimeDescriptionOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.vwAnaliticaBobinaGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.vwAnaliticaBobinaGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.vwAnaliticaBobinaGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAID"
				&TFBobinaId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFBobinaId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINANOSERIE"
				&TFBobinaNoSerie.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINANOSERIE_SEL"
				&TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSIONID"
				&TFExtrusionId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusionId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSIONEXTRUSORANOMBRE"
				&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSIONEXTRUSORANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSIONTURNONOMBRE"
				&TFExtrusionTurnoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSIONTURNONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFExtrusionTurnoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINACOLORESTACION_SEL"
				&TFBobinaColorEstacion_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFBobinaColorEstacion_Sels.FromJson(&TFBobinaColorEstacion_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAORIGEN_SEL"
				&TFBobinaOrigen_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFBobinaOrigen_Sels.FromJson(&TFBobinaOrigen_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAESTADO_SEL"
				&TFBobinaEstado_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFBobinaEstado_Sels.FromJson(&TFBobinaEstado_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAHORAINICIO"
				&TFBobinaHoraInicio.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFBobinaHoraInicio_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAHORASALIDA"
				&TFBobinaHoraSalida.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINADESVIACIONESTANDAR"
				&TFBobinaDesviacionEstandar.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFBobinaDesviacionEstandar_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAKG"
				&TFBobinaKg.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFBobinaKg_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAMERMAKG"
				&TFBobinaMermaKg.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFBobinaMermaKg_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINANO"
				&TFBobinaNo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFBobinaNo_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAREPOSOENHORAS"
				&TFBobinaReposoEnHoras.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFBobinaReposoEnHoras_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSIONOPERADORNOMBRE"
				&TFExtrusionOperadorNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSIONOPERADORNOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFExtrusionOperadorNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAOBSERVACIONES"
				&TFBobinaObservaciones.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAOBSERVACIONES_SEL"
				&TFBobinaObservaciones_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINARECHAZADAOBSERVACIONES"
				&TFBobinaRechazadaObservaciones.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINARECHAZADAOBSERVACIONES_SEL"
				&TFBobinaRechazadaObservaciones_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINASILOMOLIDONOMBRE"
				&TFBobinaSiloMolidoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINASILOMOLIDONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFBobinaSiloMolidoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINASILOVIRGENNOMBRE"
				&TFBobinaSiloVirgenNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINASILOVIRGENNOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFBobinaSiloVirgenNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINALOTEVIRGEN"
				&TFBobinaLoteVirgen.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINALOTEVIRGEN_SEL"
				&TFBobinaLoteVirgen_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSIONLOTEPAQUETEADITIVOS"
				&TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSIONLOTEPAQUETEADITIVOS_SEL"
				&TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAPRODUCTOID"
				&TFBobinaProductoId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFBobinaProductoId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAPRODUCTONOMBRE"
				&TFBobinaProductoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFBobinaProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAPRODUCTOTIPOMATERIAL_SEL"
				&TFBobinaProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFBobinaProductoTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFBobinaProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAPRENSADOPRENSANOMBRE"
				&TFBobinaPrensadoPrensaNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAPRENSADOPRENSANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFBobinaPrensadoPrensaNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAINTERRUPCIONESMOTIVO"
				&TFBobinaInterrupcionesMotivo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAINTERRUPCIONESMOTIVO_SEL"
				&TFBobinaInterrupcionesMotivo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAINTERRUPCIONESTIEMPO"
				&TFBobinaInterrupcionesTiempo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFBobinaInterrupcionesTiempo_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINADOWNTIMECODE"
				&TFBobinaDownTimeCode.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINADOWNTIMECODE_SEL"
				&TFBobinaDownTimeCode_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINADOWNTIMEDESCRIPTION"
				&TFBobinaDownTimeDescription.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINADOWNTIMEDESCRIPTION_SEL"
				&TFBobinaDownTimeDescription_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"GRIDCFFILTER"
				&GridConditionalFormattingFilter.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadBobinaNoSerieOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFBobinaNoSerie = &SearchTxt
	&TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.Bobina
		Order BobinaNoSerie
		using vwAnaliticaBobinaDS(&GridConditionalFormattingFilter, &FilterFullText, &TFBobinaId, &TFBobinaId_To, &TFBobinaNoSerie, &TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel
					, &TFExtrusionId, &TFExtrusionId_To, &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre, &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusionTurnoNombre, &TFExtrusionTurnoNombre_Sel
					, &TFBobinaColorEstacion_Sels, &TFBobinaOrigen_Sels, &TFBobinaEstado_Sels, &TFBobinaHoraInicio, &TFBobinaHoraInicio_To, &TFBobinaHoraSalida
					, &TFBobinaHoraSalida_To, &TFBobinaDesviacionEstandar, &TFBobinaDesviacionEstandar_To, &TFBobinaKg, &TFBobinaKg_To, &TFBobinaMermaKg
					, &TFBobinaMermaKg_To, &TFBobinaNo, &TFBobinaNo_To, &TFBobinaReposoEnHoras, &TFBobinaReposoEnHoras_To, &TFExtrusionOperadorNombre
					, &TFExtrusionOperadorNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaObservaciones, &TFBobinaObservaciones_Sel, &TFBobinaRechazadaObservaciones, &TFBobinaRechazadaObservaciones_Sel, &TFBobinaSiloMolidoNombre
					, &TFBobinaSiloMolidoNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaSiloVirgenNombre, &TFBobinaSiloVirgenNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaLoteVirgen, &TFBobinaLoteVirgen_Sel, &TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos
					, &TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos_Sel, &TFBobinaProductoId, &TFBobinaProductoId_To, &TFBobinaProductoNombre, &TFBobinaProductoNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaProductoTipoMaterial_Sels
					, &TFBobinaPrensadoPrensaNombre, &TFBobinaPrensadoPrensaNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesMotivo, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesMotivo_Sel, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesTiempo, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesTiempo_To
					, &TFBobinaDownTimeCode, &TFBobinaDownTimeCode_Sel, &TFBobinaDownTimeDescription, &TFBobinaDownTimeDescription_Sel)
		Where BobinaHoraInicio>= &NowDate

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.Bobina
			Order BobinaNoSerie
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not BobinaNoSerie.IsEmpty()
			&Option = BobinaNoSerie
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadBobinaRechazadaObservacionesOptions'

		Where DB.DB.BobinaHoraInicio>= &NowDate

		If not BobinaSiloMolidoNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = BobinaSiloMolidoNombre
			
			&InsertIndex = 1

				&InsertIndex = &InsertIndex + 1
			EndDo
			&Options.Add(&Option, &InsertIndex)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()), &InsertIndex)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf

Sub 'LoadBobinaPrensadoPrensaNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFBobinaPrensadoPrensaNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFBobinaPrensadoPrensaNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.Bobina
		using vwAnaliticaBobinaDS(&GridConditionalFormattingFilter, &FilterFullText, &TFBobinaId, &TFBobinaId_To, &TFBobinaNoSerie, &TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel
					, &TFExtrusionId, &TFExtrusionId_To, &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre, &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusionTurnoNombre, &TFExtrusionTurnoNombre_Sel
					, &TFBobinaColorEstacion_Sels, &TFBobinaOrigen_Sels, &TFBobinaEstado_Sels, &TFBobinaHoraInicio, &TFBobinaHoraInicio_To, &TFBobinaHoraSalida
					, &TFBobinaHoraSalida_To, &TFBobinaDesviacionEstandar, &TFBobinaDesviacionEstandar_To, &TFBobinaKg, &TFBobinaKg_To, &TFBobinaMermaKg
					, &TFBobinaMermaKg_To, &TFBobinaNo, &TFBobinaNo_To, &TFBobinaReposoEnHoras, &TFBobinaReposoEnHoras_To, &TFExtrusionOperadorNombre
					, &TFExtrusionOperadorNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaObservaciones, &TFBobinaObservaciones_Sel, &TFBobinaRechazadaObservaciones, &TFBobinaRechazadaObservaciones_Sel, &TFBobinaSiloMolidoNombre
					, &TFBobinaSiloMolidoNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaSiloVirgenNombre, &TFBobinaSiloVirgenNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaLoteVirgen, &TFBobinaLoteVirgen_Sel, &TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos
					, &TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos_Sel, &TFBobinaProductoId, &TFBobinaProductoId_To, &TFBobinaProductoNombre, &TFBobinaProductoNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaProductoTipoMaterial_Sels
					, &TFBobinaPrensadoPrensaNombre, &TFBobinaPrensadoPrensaNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesMotivo, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesMotivo_Sel, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesTiempo, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesTiempo_To
					, &TFBobinaDownTimeCode, &TFBobinaDownTimeCode_Sel, &TFBobinaDownTimeDescription, &TFBobinaDownTimeDescription_Sel)
		Where BobinaHoraInicio>= &NowDate

		If not BobinaPrensadoPrensaNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = BobinaPrensadoPrensaNombre
			
			&InsertIndex = 1
			Do while &InsertIndex <= &Options.Count AND &Options.Item(&InsertIndex) < &Option
				&InsertIndex = &InsertIndex + 1
			EndDo
			If &InsertIndex <= &Options.Count AND &Options.Item(&InsertIndex) = &Option
				&count.FromString(&OptionIndexes.Item(&InsertIndex))
				&count += 1
				&OptionIndexes.Remove(&InsertIndex)
				&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()), &InsertIndex)
			Else
				&Options.Add(&Option, &InsertIndex)
				&OptionIndexes.Add(!'1', &InsertIndex)
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

					, &TFExtrusionOperadorNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaObservaciones, &TFBobinaObservaciones_Sel, &TFBobinaRechazadaObservaciones, &TFBobinaRechazadaObservaciones_Sel, &TFBobinaSiloMolidoNombre
					, &TFBobinaSiloMolidoNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaSiloVirgenNombre, &TFBobinaSiloVirgenNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaLoteVirgen, &TFBobinaLoteVirgen_Sel, &TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos
					, &TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos_Sel, &TFBobinaProductoId, &TFBobinaProductoId_To, &TFBobinaProductoNombre, &TFBobinaProductoNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaProductoTipoMaterial_Sels
					, &TFBobinaPrensadoPrensaNombre, &TFBobinaPrensadoPrensaNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesMotivo, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesMotivo_Sel, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesTiempo, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesTiempo_To
					, &TFBobinaDownTimeCode, &TFBobinaDownTimeCode_Sel, &TFBobinaDownTimeDescription, &TFBobinaDownTimeDescription_Sel)
		Where BobinaHoraInicio>= &NowDate

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.Bobina
			Order DB.BobinaDownTimeCode
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not BobinaDownTimeCode.IsEmpty()
			&Option = BobinaDownTimeCode
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadBobinaDownTimeDescriptionOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFBobinaDownTimeDescription = &SearchTxt
	&TFBobinaDownTimeDescription_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.Bobina
		Order BobinaDownTimeDescription
		using vwAnaliticaBobinaDS(&GridConditionalFormattingFilter, &FilterFullText, &TFBobinaId, &TFBobinaId_To, &TFBobinaNoSerie, &TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel
					, &TFExtrusionId, &TFExtrusionId_To, &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre, &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusionTurnoNombre, &TFExtrusionTurnoNombre_Sel
					, &TFBobinaColorEstacion_Sels, &TFBobinaOrigen_Sels, &TFBobinaEstado_Sels, &TFBobinaHoraInicio, &TFBobinaHoraInicio_To, &TFBobinaHoraSalida
					, &TFBobinaHoraSalida_To, &TFBobinaDesviacionEstandar, &TFBobinaDesviacionEstandar_To, &TFBobinaKg, &TFBobinaKg_To, &TFBobinaMermaKg
					, &TFBobinaMermaKg_To, &TFBobinaNo, &TFBobinaNo_To, &TFBobinaReposoEnHoras, &TFBobinaReposoEnHoras_To, &TFExtrusionOperadorNombre
					, &TFExtrusionOperadorNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaObservaciones, &TFBobinaObservaciones_Sel, &TFBobinaRechazadaObservaciones, &TFBobinaRechazadaObservaciones_Sel, &TFBobinaSiloMolidoNombre
					, &TFBobinaSiloMolidoNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaSiloVirgenNombre, &TFBobinaSiloVirgenNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaLoteVirgen, &TFBobinaLoteVirgen_Sel, &TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos
					, &TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos_Sel, &TFBobinaProductoId, &TFBobinaProductoId_To, &TFBobinaProductoNombre, &TFBobinaProductoNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaProductoTipoMaterial_Sels
					, &TFBobinaPrensadoPrensaNombre, &TFBobinaPrensadoPrensaNombre_Sel, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesMotivo, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesMotivo_Sel, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesTiempo, &TFBobinaInterrupcionesTiempo_To
					, &TFBobinaDownTimeCode, &TFBobinaDownTimeCode_Sel, &TFBobinaDownTimeDescription, &TFBobinaDownTimeDescription_Sel)
		Where BobinaHoraInicio>= &NowDate

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.Bobina
			Order BobinaDownTimeDescription
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not BobinaDownTimeDescription.IsEmpty()
			&Option = BobinaDownTimeDescription
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== WebPanel: WWPBaseObjects.AuditDeleted ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid1_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid1.InternalName
	Grid1.Rows = Page.Rows
	&Grid1CurrentPage = 1
	&Grid1CurrentPage.Visible = False
	&Grid1PageCount = -1
	&IsAuthorized_AuditDate = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'auditview_Execute')
	
	Grid1PaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid1.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	//The variable '&Grid1PageCount' must be assigned manually in order to get a correct behaviour of the Pagination Bar.
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid1.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	//this code should be inside the For Each used to load the grid
	If (&IsAuthorized_AuditDate)
		AuditDate.Link = AuditView.Link(AuditId, '')
	Endif
	Do Case
		Case AuditAction = 'Delete'
			&Grid1Badge = "Deleted"
			&Grid1Badge.TooltipText = "Deleted"
			&Grid1Badge.Class = !' AttributeTagDanger BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Otherwise
			&Grid1Badge = ''
			&Grid1Badge.TooltipText = ''
			&Grid1Badge.Class = !''
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid1PaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case Grid1PaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			&Grid1CurrentPage -= 1
			Grid1.PreviousPage()
		Case Grid1PaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			&Grid1CurrentPage += 1
			Grid1.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(Grid1PaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			&Grid1CurrentPage = &PageToGo
			Grid1.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid1PaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid1.Rows = Grid1PaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	&Grid1CurrentPage = 1
	Grid1.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid1.OnLineActivate (Event) ---
wcAuditAttributes.Object = AuditAttributes.Create(AuditId)

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&AuditTableName);


=== Procedure: admin.ImprimirBobinasGetFilterData ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_EXTRUSIONEXTRUSORANOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadExtrusionExtrusoraNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_BOBINANOSERIE'
		Do 'LoadBobinaNoSerieOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"admin.ImprimirBobinasGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"admin.ImprimirBobinasGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"admin.ImprimirBobinasGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSIONEXTRUSORANOMBRE"
				&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSIONEXTRUSORANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSIONFECHA"
				&TFExtrusionFecha.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusionFecha_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINANOSERIE"
				&TFBobinaNoSerie.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINANOSERIE_SEL"
				&TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAORIGEN_SEL"
				&TFBobinaOrigen_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFBobinaOrigen_Sels.FromJson(&TFBobinaOrigen_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAHORAINICIO"
				&TFBobinaHoraInicio.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFBobinaHoraInicio_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAHORASALIDA"
				&TFBobinaHoraSalida.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAESTADO_SEL"
				&TFBobinaEstado_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFBobinaEstado_Sels.FromJson(&TFBobinaEstado_SelsJson)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadExtrusionExtrusoraNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each
		Order ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre
		Where (ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre like !'%' + &FilterFullText) OR (BobinaNoSerie like !'%' + &FilterFullText) OR ("a" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaOrigen = !"A") OR ("b" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaOrigen = !"B") OR ("en proceso" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"En Proceso") OR ("en medición" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"En Medición") OR ("reposo" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Reposo") OR ("molino" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Molino") OR ("disponible" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Disponible") OR ("en prensado" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"En Prensado") OR ("pausada" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Pausada") OR ("desmontada" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Desmontada") OR ("transferida" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Transferida") OR ("rechazada" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Rechazada") OR ("consumida" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Consumida") OR (BobinaDesviacionEstandar.ToString() like !'%' + &FilterFullText) When not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		Where ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre like &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre when &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel.IsEmpty() AND (not &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.IsEmpty())
		Where ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre = &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel when not &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		Where ExtrusionFecha >= &TFExtrusionFecha when not &TFExtrusionFecha.IsEmpty()
		Where ExtrusionFecha <= &TFExtrusionFecha_To when not &TFExtrusionFecha_To.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaNoSerie like &TFBobinaNoSerie when &TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel.IsEmpty() AND (not &TFBobinaNoSerie.IsEmpty())
		Where BobinaNoSerie = &TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel when not &TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaOrigen in &TFBobinaOrigen_Sels when &TFBobinaOrigen_Sels.Count > 0
		Where BobinaHoraInicio >= &TFBobinaHoraInicio when not &TFBobinaHoraInicio.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaHoraInicio <= &TFBobinaHoraInicio_To when not &TFBobinaHoraInicio_To.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaHoraSalida >= &TFBobinaHoraSalida when not &TFBobinaHoraSalida.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaHoraSalida <= &TFBobinaHoraSalida_To when not &TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaEstado in &TFBobinaEstado_Sels when &TFBobinaEstado_Sels.Count > 0

		&count = 0
		For Each
			Order ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadBobinaNoSerieOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFBobinaNoSerie = &SearchTxt
	&TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each
		Order BobinaNoSerie
		Where (ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre like !'%' + &FilterFullText) OR (BobinaNoSerie like !'%' + &FilterFullText) OR ("a" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaOrigen = !"A") OR ("b" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaOrigen = !"B") OR ("en proceso" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"En Proceso") OR ("en medición" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"En Medición") OR ("reposo" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Reposo") OR ("molino" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Molino") OR ("disponible" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Disponible") OR ("en prensado" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"En Prensado") OR ("pausada" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Pausada") OR ("desmontada" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Desmontada") OR ("transferida" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Transferida") OR ("rechazada" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Rechazada") OR ("consumida" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Consumida") OR (BobinaDesviacionEstandar.ToString() like !'%' + &FilterFullText) When not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		Where ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre like &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre when &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel.IsEmpty() AND (not &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.IsEmpty())
		Where ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre = &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel when not &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		Where ExtrusionFecha >= &TFExtrusionFecha when not &TFExtrusionFecha.IsEmpty()
		Where ExtrusionFecha <= &TFExtrusionFecha_To when not &TFExtrusionFecha_To.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaNoSerie like &TFBobinaNoSerie when &TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel.IsEmpty() AND (not &TFBobinaNoSerie.IsEmpty())
		Where BobinaNoSerie = &TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel when not &TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaOrigen in &TFBobinaOrigen_Sels when &TFBobinaOrigen_Sels.Count > 0
		Where BobinaHoraInicio >= &TFBobinaHoraInicio when not &TFBobinaHoraInicio.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaHoraInicio <= &TFBobinaHoraInicio_To when not &TFBobinaHoraInicio_To.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaHoraSalida >= &TFBobinaHoraSalida when not &TFBobinaHoraSalida.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaHoraSalida <= &TFBobinaHoraSalida_To when not &TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaEstado in &TFBobinaEstado_Sels when &TFBobinaEstado_Sels.Count > 0

		&count = 0
		For Each
			Order BobinaNoSerie
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not BobinaNoSerie.IsEmpty()
			&Option = BobinaNoSerie
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== WebPanel: DB.BobinaWW ===

--- Start (Event) ---
ReposoTranscurrido.Call()
	ucChronometer.TickInterval = 60
	ucChronometer.Start()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Popover_DetalleBobina.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	Popover_DetalleBobina.ItemInternalName = &DetalleBobina.InternalName
	TFBobinaHoraSalida_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_BobinaHoraSalidaAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFBobinaHoraInicio_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_BobinaHoraInicioAuxDateText.InternalName)
	
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	DDC_Subscriptions.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnSubscriptions.InternalName
	
	&IsAuthorized_BobinaNoSerie = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'bobinaview_Execute')
	
	&IsAuthorized_ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'extrusionview_Execute')
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Bobina'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'DB.BobinaWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'DB.BobinaWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	Calidad.BobinaId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	BobinaNoSerie.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	ExtrusionId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	ExtrusionTurnoNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	BobinaOrigen.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	BobinaHoraInicio.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	BobinaHoraSalida.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(8).IsVisible
	BobinaKg.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(9).IsVisible
	BobinaNo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(10).IsVisible
	BobinaReposoEnHoras.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(11).IsVisible
	ExtrusionOperadorNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(12).IsVisible
	BobinaObservaciones.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(13).IsVisible
	BobinaRechazadaObservaciones.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(14).IsVisible
	BobinaSiloMolidoNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(15).IsVisible
	ExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(16).IsVisible
	Do 'InitializeTotalizers'
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	Do 'CalculateTotalizers'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'TagColumn'
					&GridConditionalFormattingFilter.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedColumnFixedFilter)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaId'
					&TFBobinaId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBobinaId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaNoSerie'
					&TFBobinaNoSerie = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionId'
					&TFExtrusionId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre'
					&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionTurnoNombre'
					&TFExtrusionTurnoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionTurnoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaOrigen'
					&TFBobinaOrigen_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFBobinaOrigen_Sels.FromJson(&TFBobinaOrigen_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaHoraInicio'
					&TFBobinaHoraInicio.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBobinaHoraInicio_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFBobinaHoraInicio_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFBobinaHoraInicio_To.Set(&TFBobinaHoraInicio_To.Year(), &TFBobinaHoraInicio_To.Month(), &TFBobinaHoraInicio_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaHoraSalida'
					&TFBobinaHoraSalida.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.Set(&TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.Year(), &TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.Month(), &TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaKg'
					&TFBobinaKg.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBobinaKg_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaNo'
					&TFBobinaNo.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBobinaNo_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaReposoEnHoras'
					&TFBobinaReposoEnHoras.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBobinaReposoEnHoras_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionOperadorNombre'
					&TFExtrusionOperadorNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionOperadorNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaObservaciones'
					&TFBobinaObservaciones = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFBobinaObservaciones_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaRechazadaObservaciones'
					&TFBobinaRechazadaObservaciones = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFBobinaRechazadaObservaciones_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaSiloMolidoNombre'
					&TFBobinaSiloMolidoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFBobinaSiloMolidoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos'
					&TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Update = !'<i class="fa fa-pen"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = Bobina.Link(TrnMode.Update, BobinaId)
	Endif
	&Delete = !'<i class="fa fa-times"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = DB.Bobina.Link(TrnMode.Delete, BobinaId)
	Endif
	&Opciones.Clear()
	&Opciones.AddItem(0, 'Opciones')
	If (&IsAuthorized_Display)
		&Opciones.AddItem(1, format(!'%1;%2', "GXM_display", !"fa fa-search"))
	Endif
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Opciones.AddItem(2, format(!'%1;%2', "GXM_update", !"fa fa-pen"))
	Endif
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Opciones.AddItem(3, format(!'%1;%2', "GX_BtnDelete", !"fa fa-times"))
	Endif
	If (BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.EnProceso)
		&Opciones.AddItem(4, 'En Pausa')
	Endif
	&Opciones.AddItem(5, 'Etiqueta')
	
	&DetalleBobina = "Detalle"
	
	If (&IsAuthorized_BobinaNoSerie)
		BobinaNoSerie.Link = BobinaView.Link(BobinaId, '')
	Endif
	If (&IsAuthorized_ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre)
		ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.Link = ExtrusionView.Link(ExtrusionId, '')
	Endif
	Do Case
		Case BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.EnMedicion
			&GridBadge = "En Medición"
			&GridBadge.TooltipText = "En Medición"
			&GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagInfo BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Case BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.Reposo
			&GridBadge = "Reposo"
			&GridBadge.TooltipText = "Reposo"
			&GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagInfoLight BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Case BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.Molino
			&GridBadge = "Molino"
			&GridBadge.TooltipText = "Molino"
			&GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagDanger BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Case BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.EnProceso
			&GridBadge = "En Proceso"
			&GridBadge.TooltipText = "En Proceso"
			&GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagWarning BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Case BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.Disponible
			&GridBadge = "Disponible"
			&GridBadge.TooltipText = "Disponible"
			&GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagSuccess BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Case BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.EnPrensado
			&GridBadge = "En Prensado"
			&GridBadge.TooltipText = "En Prensado"
			&GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagWarning BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Case BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.Pausada
			&GridBadge = "Pausada"
			&GridBadge.TooltipText = "Pausada"
			&GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagWarning BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Case BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.Desmontada
			&GridBadge = "Desmontada"
			&GridBadge.TooltipText = "Desmontada"
			&GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagInfo BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Case BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.Transferida
			&GridBadge = "Transferida"
			&GridBadge.TooltipText = "Transferida"
			&GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagInfo BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Case BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.Rechazada
			&GridBadge = "Rechazada"
			&GridBadge.TooltipText = "Rechazada"
			&GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagDanger BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Case BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.Consumida
			&GridBadge = "Consumida"
			&GridBadge.TooltipText = "Consumida"
			&GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagDanger BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Otherwise
			&GridBadge = ''
			&GridBadge.TooltipText = ''
			&GridBadge.Class = !''
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'DB.BobinaWWColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'DB.BobinaWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'DB.BobinaWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'DB.BobinaWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- &Opciones.Click (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case &Opciones = 1
			Do 'Do Display'
		Case &Opciones = 2
			Do 'Do Update'
		Case &Opciones = 3
			Do 'Do Delete'
		Case &Opciones = 4
			Do 'Do EnPausa'
		Case &Opciones = 5
			Do 'Do cmdEtiqueta'
	EndCase
	&Opciones = 0
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		DB.Bobina.Call(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(BobinaId))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDC_Subscriptions.OnLoadComponent (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPAux_WC.Object = WWP_SubscriptionsPanel.Create(!'Bobina', WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.AnyRecord, '', '')
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPAux_WC.Object = BobinaEnPrensadoWC.Create(BobinaId, &TabCode)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

ReposoTranscurrido.Call()

	Do 'SaveGridState'

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionBobinas'
					&TFExtrusionBobinas.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionBobinas_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos'
					&TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionId'
					&TFExtrusionId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre'
					&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionTurnoNombre'
					&TFExtrusionTurnoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionTurnoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionProductoNombre'
					&TFExtrusionProductoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionProductoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionTiempoInterrupcion'

					&TFExtrusionTiempoInterrupcion_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionFecha'
					&TFExtrusionFecha.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionFecha_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFExtrusionFecha_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFExtrusionFecha_To.Set(&TFExtrusionFecha_To.Year(), &TFExtrusionFecha_To.Month(), &TFExtrusionFecha_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionMeta'
					&TFExtrusionMeta.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionMeta_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionEstado'
					&TFExtrusionEstado_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFExtrusionEstado_Sels.FromJson(&TFExtrusionEstado_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionOperadorNombre'
					&TFExtrusionOperadorNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionOperadorNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso'
					&TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso_To.Set(&TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso_To.Year(), &TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso_To.Month(), &TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionHoraFinProceso'
					&TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso_To.Set(&TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso_To.Year(), &TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso_To.Month(), &TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&DetailWebComponent = !'<i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i>'
	
	&cmdRpt = !'<i class="fas fa-print"></i>'
	If (ExtrusionEstado = EstadoExtrusion.Terminada)
		&cmdRpt.Class = !'Attribute'
	Else
		&cmdRpt.Class = !'Invisible'
	Endif
	&ViewDetail = "Detalle Interrupción"
	If (ExtrusionTiempoInterrupcion > 0)
		&ViewDetail.Class = !'Attribute'
	Else
		&ViewDetail.Class = !'Invisible'
	Endif
	&Display = "GXM_display"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Display)
		&Display.Link = ExtrusionView.Link(ExtrusionId, '')
	Endif
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = DB.Extrusion.Link(TrnMode.Update, ExtrusionId)
	Endif
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = DB.Extrusion.Link(TrnMode.Delete, ExtrusionId)
	Endif
	If (&IsAuthorized_ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre)
		ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.Link = ExtrusionView.Link(ExtrusionId, '')
	Endif
	Do Case
		Case ExtrusionEstado = EstadoExtrusion.EnProceso 
			&DetailWebComponent.ColumnClass = !'WWIconActionColumn WCD_ActionColumn WWColumnWarning WWColumnWarningFirstColumn'
			&cmdRpt.ColumnClass = !'WWIconActionColumn WWColumnWarning'
			ExtrusionBobinas.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnWarning'
			ExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnWarning'
			&ViewDetail.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnWarning'
			&Display.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnWarning'
			&Update.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnWarning'
			&Delete.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnWarning'
			ExtrusionId.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnWarning hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnWarning'
			ExtrusionTurnoNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnWarning hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionProductoNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnWarning hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionTiempoInterrupcion.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnWarning hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionFecha.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnWarning hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionMeta.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnWarning hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionEstado.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnWarning hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionOperadorNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnWarning hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnWarning hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionHoraFinProceso.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnWarning hidden-xs'
		Case ExtrusionEstado = EstadoExtrusion.Programada
			&DetailWebComponent.ColumnClass = !'WWIconActionColumn WCD_ActionColumn WWColumnInfo WWColumnInfoFirstColumn'
			&cmdRpt.ColumnClass = !'WWIconActionColumn WWColumnInfo'
			ExtrusionBobinas.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnInfo'
			ExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnInfo'
			&ViewDetail.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnInfo'
			&Display.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnInfo'
			&Update.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnInfo'
			&Delete.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnInfo'
			ExtrusionId.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnInfo hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnInfo'
			ExtrusionTurnoNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnInfo hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionProductoNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnInfo hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionTiempoInterrupcion.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnInfo hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionFecha.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnInfo hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionMeta.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnInfo hidden-xs'

			ExtrusionOperadorNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnInfo hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnInfo hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionHoraFinProceso.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnInfo hidden-xs'
		Case ExtrusionEstado = EstadoExtrusion.Terminada
			&DetailWebComponent.ColumnClass = !'WWIconActionColumn WCD_ActionColumn WWColumnSuccess WWColumnSuccessFirstColumn'
			&cmdRpt.ColumnClass = !'WWIconActionColumn WWColumnSuccess'
			ExtrusionBobinas.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnSuccess'

			&ViewDetail.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnSuccess'
			&Display.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnSuccess'
			&Update.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnSuccess'
			&Delete.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnSuccess'

			ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnSuccess'
			ExtrusionTurnoNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnSuccess hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionProductoNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnSuccess hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionTiempoInterrupcion.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnSuccess hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionFecha.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnSuccess hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionMeta.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnSuccess hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionEstado.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnSuccess hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionOperadorNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnSuccess hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnSuccess hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionHoraFinProceso.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnSuccess hidden-xs'
		Case ExtrusionEstado = EstadoExtrusion.Intermedia
			&DetailWebComponent.ColumnClass = !'WWIconActionColumn WCD_ActionColumn WWColumnDanger WWColumnDangerFirstColumn'
			&cmdRpt.ColumnClass = !'WWIconActionColumn WWColumnDanger'
			ExtrusionBobinas.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnDanger'
			ExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnDanger'
			&ViewDetail.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnDanger'
			&Display.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnDanger'
			&Update.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnDanger'
			&Delete.ColumnClass = !'WWActionColumn WWColumnDanger'
			ExtrusionId.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnDanger hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnDanger'
			ExtrusionTurnoNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnDanger hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionProductoNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnDanger hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionTiempoInterrupcion.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnDanger hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionFecha.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnDanger hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionMeta.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnDanger hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionEstado.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnDanger hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionOperadorNombre.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnDanger hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnDanger hidden-xs'
			ExtrusionHoraFinProceso.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn WWColumnDanger hidden-xs'
		Otherwise
			&DetailWebComponent.ColumnClass = !'WWIconActionColumn WCD_ActionColumn'
			&cmdRpt.ColumnClass = !'WWIconActionColumn'
			ExtrusionBobinas.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn'
			ExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn'

			ExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso.ColumnClass = !'WWColumn hidden-xs'

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'DB.ExtrusionWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'DB.ExtrusionWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'DB.ExtrusionWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

=== Transaction: DB.Interrupcion ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated DownTimeCodeId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"DownTimeCodeId"
					&Insert_DownTimeCodeId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	AuditTransaction.Call(&AuditingObject,&pgmname)	
   [web]
   {
	
	If (&Mode = TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		InterrupcionWW.Call()
	Endif
	Return
   }
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&InterrupcionId);

InterrupcionId = &InterrupcionId if not &InterrupcionId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(InterrupcionId);
noprompt(InterrupcionId);

DownTimeCodeId = &Insert_DownTimeCodeId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_DownTimeCodeId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(DownTimeCodeId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_DownTimeCodeId.IsEmpty();
}

LoadAuditInterrupcion.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, InterrupcionId, &Mode) on beforeUpdate;
LoadAuditInterrupcion.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, InterrupcionId, &Mode) on beforeDelete;
LoadAuditInterrupcion.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, InterrupcionId, &Mode) If Insert on BeforeComplete;
LoadAuditInterrupcion.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, InterrupcionId, &Mode) If Update on BeforeComplete;
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: DB.InterrupcionWW ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	TFInterrupcionHoraFin_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_InterrupcionHoraFinAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_InterrupcionHoraInicioAuxDateText.InternalName)
	
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()

	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)

	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Interrupcion'

		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'DB.InterrupcionWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'DB.InterrupcionWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	InterrupcionId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	InterrupcionHoraInicio.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	InterrupcionHoraFin.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	InterrupcionTiempo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	InterrupcionConcluida.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	InterrupcionMotivo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	DownTimeCodeId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	DownTimeCodeDescription.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(8).IsVisible
	DownTimeCodeType.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(9).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InterrupcionId'
					&TFInterrupcionId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFInterrupcionId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InterrupcionHoraInicio'
					&TFInterrupcionHoraInicio.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.Set(&TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.Year(), &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.Month(), &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InterrupcionHoraFin'
					&TFInterrupcionHoraFin.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.Set(&TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.Year(), &TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.Month(), &TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InterrupcionTiempo'
					&TFInterrupcionTiempo.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFInterrupcionTiempo_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InterrupcionConcluida'
					&TFInterrupcionConcluida_Sel.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InterrupcionMotivo'
					&TFInterrupcionMotivo = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFInterrupcionMotivo_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'DownTimeCodeId'
					&TFDownTimeCodeId = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFDownTimeCodeId_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'DownTimeCodeDescription'
					&TFDownTimeCodeDescription = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFDownTimeCodeDescription_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'DownTimeCodeType'
					&TFDownTimeCodeType = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFDownTimeCodeType_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Update = !'<i class="fa fa-pen"></i>'

	Endif
	&Delete = !'<i class="fa fa-times"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)

	Endif
	If (&IsAuthorized_InterrupcionMotivo)
		InterrupcionMotivo.Link = DB.InterrupcionView.Link(InterrupcionId, '')
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'

		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'

			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise

				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase

=== Procedure: PrinterSD.BobinaReportMainMulti ===

--- Source (Source) ---



for each
	where BobinaNoSerie in &CollectionBobinaNoSerie
	
	
	
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT = ObtenerSDTEtiquetaBobina.Udp(BobinaId)
	
	&BobinaNoserie = &EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaNoSerie
	
	//&linkURL='https://sdx.genexus.com/agetqrcode.aspx?'+&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaNoSerie
	//&linkURL='https://barcode.tec-it.com/barcode.ashx?data='+&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaNoSerie + '&code=Code128'
	//&QRImage.FromURL(&linkURL)
	
	&QRImage = ObtenerBarCode.Udp(&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaNoSerie)
	
	print printBlock1

endfor

--- Rules (Rules) ---
Parm(in:&CollectionBobinaNoSerie,in:&PDFNombre);
Output_File(&PDFNombre, 'PDF');


=== SDT: PrinterSD.EtiquetaBobinaSDT ===

--- SDT Structure (Structure) ---
// SDT Extraction
(Raw representation avoided to prevent serialization errors. Core variables added to DataDictionary.)


=== Procedure: PrinterSD.ObtenerBarCode ===

--- Source (Source) ---
&ImgTxt = &StringLibrary.GetBarCodeBase64(&BarCodeValue,2)
&ImgBlob.FromBase64String(&ImgTxt)
GuardarBarCode.Call(&BarCodeValue, &ImgBlob)

For Each
	Where BarCodeValue = &BarCodeValue
	&BarCodeImage = BarCodeImage
	Exit
EndFor

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(In:&BarCodeValue, Out:&BarCodeImage);


=== Procedure: PrinterSD.ObtenerSDTEtiquetaBobina ===

--- Source (Source) ---


For each
	Where BobinaId = &BobinaId

	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaId = BobinaId
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.ExtrusionId = ExtrusionId
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.ExtrusionFecha = ExtrusionFecha
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.ExtrusionOperadorNombre = ExtrusionOperadorNombre
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaNoSerie = BobinaNoSerie
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaOrigen = BobinaOrigen
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaHoraInicio = BobinaHoraInicio
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaHoraSalida = BobinaHoraSalida
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaNo = BobinaNo
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaKg = BobinaKg
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaMermaKg = BobinaMermaKg
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaEspesor = BobinaEspesor
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaObservaciones = BobinaObservaciones
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaEstado = BobinaEstado
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaCarreras = BobinaCarreras
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaIniciaReposo = BobinaIniciaReposo
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaMinutosEnReposo = BobinaMinutosEnReposo
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaMotivoMolino = BobinaMotivoMolino
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaProductoId = BobinaProductoId
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaProductoNombre = BobinaProductoNombre
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre = ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.ExtrusionExtrusoraIdTexto = ExtrusionExtrusoraId.ToString().Trim()
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.ExtrusionLoteSilo = ExtrusionLoteSilo
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.ExtrusionSiloNombre = ExtrusionSiloNombre
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaDesviacionEstandar = BobinaDesviacionEstandar
	&EtiquetaBobinaSDT.BobinaColorEstacion = BobinaColorEstacion

	exit
endfor

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&BobinaId, out:&EtiquetaBobinaSDT);


=== Procedure: Produccion.BobinaTiempoReposo ===

--- Source (Source) ---
	&Now = Now()
	
	&Bobina.Load(&BobinaId)
	&HoraIniciaReposo = &Bobina.BobinaIniciaReposo
	&Diferencia = &Now.Difference(&HoraIniciaReposo)
	&ReposoEnMinutos = &Diferencia / 60
		
	if(&ReposoEnMinutos >= &TiempoReposo)
		&Bobina.BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.Disponible
	endif

        &Bobina.BobinaMinutosEnReposo = &ReposoEnMinutos
	&Bobina.Save()
	
	if(&Bobina.Success())
	        commit
	endif

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&BobinaId, in:&TiempoReposo);


=== Procedure: Produccion.ObtenerInterrupcionBobina ===

--- Source (Source) ---
For Each
	Order InterrupcionHoraInicio
    Where InterrupcionHoraInicio >= &BobinaHoraInicio
    Where &BobinaEstado = 'En Proceso' or InterrupcionHoraFin <= &BobinaHoraSalida
    Defined by InterrupcionId
    &AuxInterrupcionId = InterrupcionId
	For Each DB.ExtrusionInterrupcion
		Where InterrupcionId = &AuxInterrupcionId
			&InterrupcionId = InterrupcionId
		Exit
	EndFor
EndFor

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&BobinaHoraInicio, in:&BobinaHoraSalida, in:&BobinaEstado, out:&InterrupcionId);


=== Procedure: Produccion.ObtenerTiempoReposo ===

--- Source (Source) ---
	&Extrusion.Load(&ExtrusionId)
	&ExtrusoraId = &Extrusion.ExtrusionExtrusoraId
	&ProductoId = &Extrusion.ExtrusionProductoId
	
	&TiempoReposo = 0
	
	for each
		where ExtrusoraProductoId > 0
		where ExtrusoraId = &ExtrusoraId
		where ProductoId = &ProductoId
		&TiempoReposo = ExtrusoraProductoTiempoReposo
		Exit
	when none
		msg('Debe configurar el tiempo en reposo para el producto id:' + &ProductoId.ToString())
	endfor

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&ExtrusionId, out:&TiempoReposo);


=== Procedure: Produccion.SetEstadoBobina ===

--- Source (Source) ---
         
	 &Bobina.Load(&BobinaId)
	 &Bobina.BobinaEstado = &BobinaEstado
	 &Bobina.Save()
	 
	 if(&Bobina.Success())
		 commit
         endif

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&BobinaId, in:&BobinaEstado);
