Sub 'LoadExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivosOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos = &SearchTxt
	&TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each Extrusion
		Order ExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos
		using ExtrusionWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFExtrusionBobinas, &TFExtrusionBobinas_To, &TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos, &TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos_Sel, &TFExtrusionId
					, &TFExtrusionId_To, &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre, &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusionTurnoNombre, &TFExtrusionTurnoNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusionProductoNombre
					, &TFExtrusionProductoNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusionTiempoInterrupcion, &TFExtrusionTiempoInterrupcion_To, &TFExtrusionFecha, &TFExtrusionFecha_To, &TFExtrusionMeta
					, &TFExtrusionMeta_To, &TFExtrusionEstado_Sels, &TFExtrusionOperadorNombre, &TFExtrusionOperadorNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso, &TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso_To
					, &TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso, &TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso_To)
		Where ExtrusionFecha>= &NowDate

		&count = 0
		For Each Extrusion
			Order ExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadExtrusionExtrusoraNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each Extrusion
		Order ExtrusionExtrusoraId
		using ExtrusionWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFExtrusionBobinas, &TFExtrusionBobinas_To, &TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos, &TFExtrusionLotePaqueteAditivos_Sel, &TFExtrusionId
					, &TFExtrusionId_To, &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre, &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusionTurnoNombre, &TFExtrusionTurnoNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusionProductoNombre
					, &TFExtrusionProductoNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusionTiempoInterrupcion, &TFExtrusionTiempoInterrupcion_To, &TFExtrusionFecha, &TFExtrusionFecha_To, &TFExtrusionMeta
					, &TFExtrusionMeta_To, &TFExtrusionEstado_Sels, &TFExtrusionOperadorNombre, &TFExtrusionOperadorNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso, &TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso_To
					, &TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso, &TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso_To)
		Where ExtrusionFecha>= &NowDate

		&count = 0
		For Each Extrusion
			Order ExtrusionExtrusoraId
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre
			
			&InsertIndex = 1
			Do while &InsertIndex <= &Options.Count AND &Options.Item(&InsertIndex) < &Option
				&InsertIndex = &InsertIndex + 1
			EndDo
			&Options.Add(&Option, &InsertIndex)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()), &InsertIndex)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== Procedure: DB.InterrupcionWWExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"InterrupcionWWExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInterrupcionId.IsEmpty() AND &TFInterrupcionId_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Id")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFInterrupcionId
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFInterrupcionId_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInterrupcionHoraInicio.IsEmpty() AND &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Hora Inicio")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Date = &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Date = &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInterrupcionHoraFin.IsEmpty() AND &TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Hora Fin")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Date = &TFInterrupcionHoraFin
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Date = &TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInterrupcionTiempo.IsEmpty() AND &TFInterrupcionTiempo_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Tiempo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFInterrupcionTiempo
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFInterrupcionTiempo_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInterrupcionConcluida_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Concluida")
		Do Case
			Case &TFInterrupcionConcluida_Sel = 1
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "WWP_TSChecked"
			Case &TFInterrupcionConcluida_Sel = 2
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "WWP_TSUnChecked"
		EndCase
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInterrupcionMotivo_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Motivo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFInterrupcionMotivo_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFInterrupcionMotivo.IsEmpty())
			WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Motivo")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFInterrupcionMotivo)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFDownTimeCodeId_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Down Time Code Id")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFDownTimeCodeId_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFDownTimeCodeId.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Down Time Code Id")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFDownTimeCodeId)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFDownTimeCodeDescription_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Down Time Code Description")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFDownTimeCodeDescription_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFDownTimeCodeDescription.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Down Time Code Description")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFDownTimeCodeDescription)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFDownTimeCodeType_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Down Time Code Type")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFDownTimeCodeType_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFDownTimeCodeType.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Down Time Code Type")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFDownTimeCodeType)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'DB.InterrupcionWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'DB.InterrupcionWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each Interrupcion
		order InterrupcionMotivo  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InterrupcionMotivo)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InterrupcionId  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InterrupcionId)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InterrupcionHoraInicio  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InterrupcionHoraInicio)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InterrupcionHoraFin  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InterrupcionHoraFin)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InterrupcionTiempo  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InterrupcionTiempo)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InterrupcionConcluida  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InterrupcionConcluida)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order DownTimeCodeId  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (DownTimeCodeId)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order DownTimeCodeDescription  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (DownTimeCodeDescription)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order DownTimeCodeType  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (DownTimeCodeType)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using InterrupcionWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFInterrupcionId, &TFInterrupcionId_To, &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio, &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To, &TFInterrupcionHoraFin
					, &TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To, &TFInterrupcionTiempo, &TFInterrupcionTiempo_To, &TFInterrupcionConcluida_Sel, &TFInterrupcionMotivo, &TFInterrupcionMotivo_Sel
					, &TFDownTimeCodeId, &TFDownTimeCodeId_Sel, &TFDownTimeCodeDescription, &TFDownTimeCodeDescription_Sel, &TFDownTimeCodeType, &TFDownTimeCodeType_Sel)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'InterrupcionId'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = InterrupcionId
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'InterrupcionHoraInicio'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = InterrupcionHoraInicio
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'InterrupcionHoraFin'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = InterrupcionHoraFin
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'InterrupcionTiempo'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = InterrupcionTiempo
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'InterrupcionConcluida'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = InterrupcionConcluida.ToString()
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'InterrupcionMotivo'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(InterrupcionMotivo)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'DownTimeCodeId'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(DownTimeCodeId)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'DownTimeCodeDescription'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(DownTimeCodeDescription)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'DownTimeCodeType'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(DownTimeCodeType)
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"InterrupcionId", '', !'Id', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"InterrupcionHoraInicio", '', !'Hora Inicio', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"InterrupcionHoraFin", '', !'Hora Fin', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"InterrupcionTiempo", '', !'Tiempo', True, '')
	WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"InterrupcionConcluida", '', !'Concluida', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"InterrupcionMotivo", '', !'Motivo', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"DownTimeCodeId", '', !'Down Time Code Id', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"DownTimeCodeDescription", '', !'Down Time Code Description', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"DownTimeCodeType", '', !'Down Time Code Type', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'DB.InterrupcionWWColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"DB.InterrupcionWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"DB.InterrupcionWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"DB.InterrupcionWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINTERRUPCIONID"
				&TFInterrupcionId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFInterrupcionId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINTERRUPCIONHORAINICIO"
				&TFInterrupcionHoraInicio.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINTERRUPCIONHORAFIN"
				&TFInterrupcionHoraFin.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINTERRUPCIONTIEMPO"
				&TFInterrupcionTiempo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFInterrupcionTiempo_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINTERRUPCIONCONCLUIDA_SEL"
				&TFInterrupcionConcluida_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINTERRUPCIONMOTIVO"
				&TFInterrupcionMotivo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINTERRUPCIONMOTIVO_SEL"
				&TFInterrupcionMotivo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODEID"
				&TFDownTimeCodeId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODEID_SEL"
				&TFDownTimeCodeId_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODEDESCRIPTION"
				&TFDownTimeCodeDescription.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODEDESCRIPTION_SEL"
				&TFDownTimeCodeDescription_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODETYPE"
				&TFDownTimeCodeType.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODETYPE_SEL"
				&TFDownTimeCodeType_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

=== Procedure: DB.InterrupcionWWExportReport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'interrupcionww_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Interrupcion List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInterrupcionId.IsEmpty() AND &TFInterrupcionId_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFInterrupcionId
		&TFInterrupcionId_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Id", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFInterrupcionId_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInterrupcionHoraInicio.IsEmpty() AND &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFInterrupcionHoraInicio
		&TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Hora Inicio", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInterrupcionHoraFin.IsEmpty() AND &TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFInterrupcionHoraFin
		&TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Hora Fin", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFInterrupcionHoraFin_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInterrupcionTiempo.IsEmpty() AND &TFInterrupcionTiempo_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFInterrupcionTiempo
		&TFInterrupcionTiempo_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Tiempo", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFInterrupcionTiempo_To
	EndIf
	If not &TFInterrupcionConcluida_Sel.IsEmpty()
		Do Case
			Case &TFInterrupcionConcluida_Sel = 1
				&FilterTFInterrupcionConcluida_SelValueDescription = "WWP_TSChecked" 
			Case &TFInterrupcionConcluida_Sel = 2
				&FilterTFInterrupcionConcluida_SelValueDescription = "WWP_TSUnChecked" 
		EndCase

		print printBlockTFInterrupcionConcluida_Sel
	EndIf
	If not &TFInterrupcionMotivo_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFInterrupcionMotivo_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFInterrupcionMotivo.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFInterrupcionMotivo
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFDownTimeCodeId_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFDownTimeCodeId_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFDownTimeCodeId.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFDownTimeCodeId
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFDownTimeCodeDescription_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFDownTimeCodeDescription_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFDownTimeCodeDescription.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFDownTimeCodeDescription
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFDownTimeCodeType_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFDownTimeCodeType_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFDownTimeCodeType.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFDownTimeCodeType
		EndIf
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each Interrupcion
		order InterrupcionMotivo  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InterrupcionMotivo)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InterrupcionId  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InterrupcionId)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InterrupcionHoraInicio  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InterrupcionHoraInicio)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InterrupcionHoraFin  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InterrupcionHoraFin)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InterrupcionTiempo  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InterrupcionTiempo)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InterrupcionConcluida  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InterrupcionConcluida)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order DownTimeCodeId  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (DownTimeCodeId)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order DownTimeCodeDescription  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (DownTimeCodeDescription)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order DownTimeCodeType  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (DownTimeCodeType)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using InterrupcionWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFInterrupcionId, &TFInterrupcionId_To, &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio, &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To, &TFInterrupcionHoraFin
					, &TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To, &TFInterrupcionTiempo, &TFInterrupcionTiempo_To, &TFInterrupcionConcluida_Sel, &TFInterrupcionMotivo, &TFInterrupcionMotivo_Sel
					, &TFDownTimeCodeId, &TFDownTimeCodeId_Sel, &TFDownTimeCodeDescription, &TFDownTimeCodeDescription_Sel, &TFDownTimeCodeType, &TFDownTimeCodeType_Sel)

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"DB.InterrupcionWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"DB.InterrupcionWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"DB.InterrupcionWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINTERRUPCIONID"
				&TFInterrupcionId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFInterrupcionId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINTERRUPCIONHORAINICIO"
				&TFInterrupcionHoraInicio.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINTERRUPCIONHORAFIN"
				&TFInterrupcionHoraFin.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINTERRUPCIONTIEMPO"
				&TFInterrupcionTiempo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFInterrupcionTiempo_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINTERRUPCIONCONCLUIDA_SEL"
				&TFInterrupcionConcluida_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINTERRUPCIONMOTIVO"
				&TFInterrupcionMotivo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINTERRUPCIONMOTIVO_SEL"
				&TFInterrupcionMotivo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODEID"
				&TFDownTimeCodeId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODEID_SEL"
				&TFDownTimeCodeId_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODEDESCRIPTION"
				&TFDownTimeCodeDescription.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODEDESCRIPTION_SEL"
				&TFDownTimeCodeDescription_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODETYPE"
				&TFDownTimeCodeType.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODETYPE_SEL"
				&TFDownTimeCodeType_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

Sub 'LoadInterrupcionMotivoOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFInterrupcionMotivo = &SearchTxt
	&TFInterrupcionMotivo_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each Interrupcion
		Order InterrupcionMotivo
		using InterrupcionWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFInterrupcionId, &TFInterrupcionId_To, &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio, &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To, &TFInterrupcionHoraFin
					, &TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To, &TFInterrupcionTiempo, &TFInterrupcionTiempo_To, &TFInterrupcionConcluida_Sel, &TFInterrupcionMotivo, &TFInterrupcionMotivo_Sel
					, &TFDownTimeCodeId, &TFDownTimeCodeId_Sel, &TFDownTimeCodeDescription, &TFDownTimeCodeDescription_Sel, &TFDownTimeCodeType, &TFDownTimeCodeType_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each Interrupcion
			Order InterrupcionMotivo
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not InterrupcionMotivo.IsEmpty()
			&Option = InterrupcionMotivo
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== Procedure: DB.LoadAuditInterrupcion ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

If &SaveOldValues = !'Y'
	If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Delete or &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
		Do 'LoadOldValues'
	EndIf
Else
	Do 'LoadNewValues'
EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadOldValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each Interrupcion
		Where InterrupcionId = &InterrupcionId
		&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
		&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

		&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'Interrupcion'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = &ActualMode
		&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = InterrupcionId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionHoraInicio'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Hora Inicio'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = InterrupcionHoraInicio.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionHoraFin'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Hora Fin'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = InterrupcionHoraFin.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionTiempo'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Tiempo'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = InterrupcionTiempo.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionConcluida'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Concluida'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = InterrupcionConcluida.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionMotivo'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Motivo'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = InterrupcionMotivo.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'DownTimeCodeId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Down Time Code Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = DownTimeCodeId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'DownTimeCodeName'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Down Time Code Name'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False

Sub 'LoadNewValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each Interrupcion
		Where InterrupcionId = &InterrupcionId
		If &ActualMode = GeneXus.TrnMode.Insert

			&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
			&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new Common.AuditingObject.RecordItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'Interrupcion'
			&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new Discussions.AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionHoraInicio'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Hora Inicio'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionHoraInicio.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionHoraFin'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Hora Fin'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionHoraFin.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.Common.AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionTiempo'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Tiempo'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionTiempo.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionConcluida'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Concluida'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionConcluida.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionMotivo'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Motivo'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = WWPBaseObjects.InterrupcionMotivo.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'DownTimeCodeId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Down Time Code Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = Discussions.DownTimeCodeId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'DownTimeCodeName'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Down Time Code Name'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = DownTimeCodeName.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'DownTimeCodeType'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Down Time Code Type'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = DownTimeCodeType.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		EndIf
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
			For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionHoraInicio'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionHoraInicio.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionHoraFin'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionHoraFin.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionTiempo'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionTiempo.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionConcluida'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionConcluida.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionMotivo'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionMotivo.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'DownTimeCodeId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = DownTimeCodeId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'DownTimeCodeName'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = DB.DownTimeCodeName.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'DownTimeCodeType'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = DownTimeCodeType.ToString()

						EndCase
					EndFor
			EndFor
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(in:&SaveOldValues, inout:&AuditingObject, in: &InterrupcionId, in:&ActualMode);

=== Procedure: PrinterSD.GuardarBarCode ===

--- Source (Source) ---
For Each
	Where BarCodeValue = &BarCodeValue
	delete
EndFor
&datetime = datetime.Now()
&datetime = &datetime.AddDays(-1)
For Each
	Where BarCodeDateTime < &datetime or BarCodeDateTime.IsNull()
	delete
EndFor


New
	BarCodeValue = &BarCodeValue
	BarCodeImage = &ImgBlob
	BarCodeDateTime = datetime.Now()
endnew
commit

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(In:&BarCodeValue,In: &ImgBlob);


=== Procedure: PrinterSD.RptExtrusion ===

--- Source (Source) ---
&SDTRptExtrusion = DPSDTRptExtrusion.Udp(&ExtrusionId)
&SDTExtrusionResultado = DPExtrusionResultado.Udp(&ExtrusionId)
//debugger.Call(niveldebug.Informativo, &Pgmname, &SDTRptExtrusion.ToJson())
header
	
	print pb_header
	
end

&SDTBobina = BobinaDP.Udp(&ExtrusionId, '', 0)
//debugger.Call(niveldebug.Informativo, &Pgmname, &SDTBobina.ToJson())

print pb_header_bobina_a

For &SDTBobinaItem In &SDTBobina
	
	Do Case
		
		Case &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaOrigen = OrigenBobina.A
			print If detail
			print pb_body_bobina_a
			&ABobinaKg += &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaKg
			&ABobinaMermaKg += &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaMermaKg
	EndCase
	
EndFor

&SDTRptExtrusion.ABobinaTotalKgTexto = &ABobinaKg.ToString().Trim()

print pb_foot_bobina_a

print pb_header_bobina_b

For &SDTBobinaItem In &SDTBobina
	
	Do Case
		
		Case &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaOrigen = OrigenBobina.B
			print If detail
			print pb_body_bobina_b
			&BBobinaKg += &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaKg
			&BBobinaMermaKg += &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaMermaKg
	EndCase
	
EndFor

&SDTRptExtrusion.BBobinaTotalKgTexto = &BBobinaKg.ToString().Trim()

print pb_foot_bobina_b


print Interrupcion_header
for each 
	where ExtrusionId = &ExtrusionId
	&InterrupcionHoraInicio  = InterrupcionHoraInicio
	&InterrupcionHoraFin = InterrupcionHoraFin
	&InterrupcionMotivo = InterrupcionMotivo
	
	print Interrupcion_Body
	
when none

endfor

	
	




&BobinaKg = &ABobinaKg + &BBobinaKg
&BobinaMermaKg = &ABobinaMermaKg + &BBobinaMermaKg

&SDTRptExtrusion.KgUtilesTexto = &BobinaKg.ToFormattedString()
&SDTRptExtrusion.kgMermaTexto = &BobinaMermaKg.ToFormattedString()

print pb_footer

--- Rules (Rules) ---
Parm(in:&ExtrusionId,in:&PDFNombre);
Output_File(&PDFNombre, 'PDF');

	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)

	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Audit'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1

		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = WWPBaseObjects.GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	AuditId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	AuditDate.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	AuditTableName.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	AuditTableKey.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	AuditDescription.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	AuditShortDescription.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible

	SecUserId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(8).IsVisible
	AuditAction.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(9).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'AuditId'
					&TFAuditId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFAuditId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'AuditDate'
					&TFAuditDate.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFAuditDate_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFAuditDate_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFAuditDate_To.Set(&TFAuditDate_To.Year(), &TFAuditDate_To.Month(), &TFAuditDate_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'AuditTableName'
					&TFAuditTableName = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFAuditTableName_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'AuditTableKey'
					&TFAuditTableKey.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFAuditTableKey_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'AuditDescription'
					&TFAuditDescription = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFAuditDescription_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'AuditShortDescription'
					&TFAuditShortDescription = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFAuditShortDescription_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'GAMUserGUID'
					&TFGAMUserGUID = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFGAMUserGUID_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'SecUserId'
					&TFSecUserId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFSecUserId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'AuditAction'
					&TFAuditAction = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFAuditAction_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Update = !'<i class="fa fa-pen"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = Audit.Link(TrnMode.Update, AuditId)
	Endif
	&Delete = !'<i class="fa fa-times"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = WWPBaseObjects.Audit.Link(TrnMode.Delete, AuditId)
	Endif
	If (&IsAuthorized_AuditDate)
		AuditDate.Link = AuditView.Link(AuditId, '')
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			WWPBaseObjects.ManageFilters.Popup(!'WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	ExtrusionInterrupcionId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	ExtrusionId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	InterrupcionId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionInterrupcionId'
					&TFExtrusionInterrupcionId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionInterrupcionId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionId'
					&TFExtrusionId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InterrupcionId'
					&TFInterrupcionId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFInterrupcionId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Update = !'<i class="fa fa-pen"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = DB.ExtrusionInterrupcion.Link(TrnMode.Update, ExtrusionInterrupcionId)
	Endif
	&Delete = !'<i class="fa fa-times"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = DB.ExtrusionInterrupcion.Link(TrnMode.Delete, ExtrusionInterrupcionId)
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'DB.ExtrusionInterrupcionWWColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'DB.ExtrusionInterrupcionWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'DB.ExtrusionInterrupcionWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'DB.ExtrusionInterrupcionWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		DB.ExtrusionInterrupcion.Call(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(ExtrusionInterrupcionId))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDC_Subscriptions.OnLoadComponent (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPAux_WC.Object = WWP_SubscriptionsPanel.Create(!'ExtrusionInterrupcion', WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.AnyRecord, '', '')
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: DB.LoadAuditExtrusionInterrupcion ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

If &SaveOldValues = !'Y'
	If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Delete or &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
		Do 'LoadOldValues'
	EndIf
Else
	Do 'LoadNewValues'
EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadOldValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each ExtrusionInterrupcion
		Where SAE.ExtrusionInterrupcionId = &ExtrusionInterrupcionId
		&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
		&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

		&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'ExtrusionInterrupcion'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = &ActualMode
		&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusionInterrupcionId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Interrupcion Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ExtrusionInterrupcionId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusionId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Extrusion Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ExtrusionId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Interrupcion Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = InterrupcionId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadNewValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each ExtrusionInterrupcion
		Where ExtrusionInterrupcionId = &ExtrusionInterrupcionId
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Insert

			&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
			&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'ExtrusionInterrupcion'
			&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusionInterrupcionId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Interrupcion Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusionInterrupcionId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new SAE.AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusionId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Extrusion Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusionId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Interrupcion Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		EndIf
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
			For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusionInterrupcionId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusionInterrupcionId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusionId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusionId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionId.ToString()

						EndCase
					EndFor
			EndFor
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(in:&SaveOldValues, inout:&AuditingObject, in: &ExtrusionInterrupcionId, in:&ActualMode);

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

=== DataProvider: Produccion.BobinaDP ===

--- Source (Source) ---
SDTBobina
{
	SDTBobinaItem
	where ExtrusionId = &ExtrusionId when &ExtrusionId > 0
	where BobinaEstado = &BobinaEstado when Not &BobinaEstado.IsEmpty()
	where BobinaProductoId = &ProductoId when &ProductoId > 0
	{
		BobinaId = BobinaId
		ExtrusionId = ExtrusionId
		BobinaOrigen = BobinaOrigen
		BobinaHoraInicio = BobinaHoraInicio
		HoraInicio = BobinaHoraInicio
		BobinaHoraSalida = BobinaHoraSalida
		HoraSalida = BobinaHoraSalida
		BobinaNo = BobinaNo
		BobinaDesviacionEstandar = BobinaDesviacionEstandar
		BobinaColorEstacion = BobinaColorEstacion
		BobinaKg = BobinaKg
		BobinaKgTexto = trim(BobinaKg.ToString())
		BobinaMermaKg = BobinaMermaKg
		BobinaMermaKgTexto = trim(BobinaMermaKg.ToString())
		BobinaEspesor = BobinaEspesor
		BobinaObservaciones = BobinaObservaciones
		BobinaNoSerie = BobinaNoSerie
		BobinaEstado = BobinaEstado
		BobinaMotivoMolino = BobinaMotivoMolino
		MotivoObservaciones = iif(BobinaMotivoMolino = MotivoMolino.NoAplica,'',BobinaMotivoMolino) + ' ' + BobinaObservaciones
		BobinaProductoId = BobinaProductoId
		BobinaProductoNombre = BobinaProductoNombre
		BobinaCarreras = BobinaCarreras
		BobinaIniciaReposo = BobinaIniciaReposo
		BobinaMinutosEnReposo = BobinaMinutosEnReposo
		BobinaEtiqueta = '<b>' + BobinaNo.ToFormattedString() + BobinaOrigen.Trim() + '</b>'
	}
}

=== Procedure: Web.Debugger ===

--- Source (Source) ---
/*
 Niveles de debug:
0 - Apagado
1 - Informativo
2 - Advertencia
3 - Debug
4 - Error
5 - Critico
El Nivel de debug detallará a partir de que nivel se desea informar:
	Si por ejemplo el parámetro indica 0(Apagado) -> no se generan logs
	Si por ejemplo el parámetro indica 1(Critico) -> se muestran solo los críticos
	Si por ejemplo el parámetro indica 2(Error) -> se muestran los de tipo error y críticos
	Si por ejemplo el parámetro indica 3(Degub) -> se muestran los de tipo error, degub y críticos
	Si por ejemplo el parámetro indica 3(Advertencia) -> se muestran los de tipo error, degub, advertencia y críticos
	Si por ejemplo el parámetro indica 5(Informativo) -> se muestran los de tipo error, degub, advertencia, informativos y críticos
	
*/

//call("CargarContexto", &Contexto)
&Usuario = &WebSession.Get('UserName').ToString()


&HTTP_HOST= &HttpRequest.BaseUrl.Replace('/','')
&HTTP_HOST= &HTTP_HOST.Replace(':','')
&FechaArchivo = Now()
//Se carga el nivel del debug configurado en base de datos
&NivelDebugConfigurado = NivelDebug.Informativo
//Se carga el tipo de debugg base de datos o archivo
&TipoDebug = TipoDebug.Archivo
&NivelDebugDescripcion = &NivelDebug.EnumerationDescription()

//valida si el debug esta prendido o esta dentro del rango
if &NivelDebugConfigurado  >= &NivelDebug
	do case
		case &TipoDebug = TipoDebug.BaseDatos
			//guardar en base de datos
		case &TipoDebug = TipoDebug.Archivo
			//guardad en archivo
			Do 'GuardarArchivo'
	endcase
else
	return
endif


sub 'GuardarArchivo'
	&NombreArchivo =  &HTTP_HOST.Trim() + "_" + &FechaArchivo.Year().ToString().Trim()+&FechaArchivo.Month().ToString().Trim()+&FechaArchivo.Day().ToString().Trim() + ".log"
	
	&MensajeDebug =  "-> Usuario: "+ &Usuario.ToString() +" | "+&Time.ToString().Trim()+" ("+&NivelDebugDescripcion.Trim()+") "+"["+&Programa.ToString().Trim()+"] -> "
	&MensajeDebug = &MensajeDebug + &Log
	&ResultFile = DFWOpen(&NombreArchivo,"","",1)
	&ResultFile = DFWPTxt(&MensajeDebug)
	&ResultFile = DFWNext()
	&ResultFile = DFWClose()
endsub

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&NivelDebug,&Programa,&Log);


=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"AuditWWExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFAuditId.IsEmpty() AND &TFAuditId_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Id")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFAuditId
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFAuditId_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFAuditDate.IsEmpty() AND &TFAuditDate_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Date")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Date = &TFAuditDate
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Date = &TFAuditDate_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFAuditTableName_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Table Name")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFAuditTableName_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFAuditTableName.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Table Name")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFAuditTableName)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFAuditTableKey.IsEmpty() AND &TFAuditTableKey_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Table Key")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFAuditTableKey
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFAuditTableKey_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFAuditDescription_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Description")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(&TFAuditDescription_Sel, 1, 1000))
	Else
		If not (&TFAuditDescription.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Description")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(&TFAuditDescription, 1, 1000))
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFAuditShortDescription_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Short Description")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFAuditShortDescription_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFAuditShortDescription.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Short Description")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFAuditShortDescription)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFGAMUserGUID_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "GUID")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFGAMUserGUID_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFGAMUserGUID.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "GUID")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFGAMUserGUID)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFSecUserId.IsEmpty() AND &TFSecUserId_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "User Id")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFSecUserId
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFSecUserId_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFAuditAction_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Action")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFAuditAction_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFAuditAction.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Action")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFAuditAction)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each Audit
		order AuditDate  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditDate)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditId  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditId)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditTableName  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditTableName)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditTableKey  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditTableKey)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditDescription  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditDescription)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditShortDescription  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditShortDescription)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order GAMUserGUID  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (GAMUserGUID)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SecUserId  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SecUserId)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditAction  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditAction)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using AuditWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFAuditId, &TFAuditId_To, &TFAuditDate, &TFAuditDate_To, &TFAuditTableName
					, &TFAuditTableName_Sel, &TFAuditTableKey, &TFAuditTableKey_To, &TFAuditDescription, &TFAuditDescription_Sel, &TFAuditShortDescription
					, &TFAuditShortDescription_Sel, &TFGAMUserGUID, &TFGAMUserGUID_Sel, &TFSecUserId, &TFSecUserId_To, &TFAuditAction
					, &TFAuditAction_Sel)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'AuditId'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = AuditId
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'AuditDate'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = AuditDate
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'AuditTableName'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(AuditTableName)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'AuditTableKey'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = AuditTableKey
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'AuditDescription'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(AuditDescription, 1, 1000))
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'AuditShortDescription'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(AuditShortDescription)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'GAMUserGUID'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(GAMUserGUID)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SecUserId'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = SecUserId
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'AuditAction'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(AuditAction)
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"AuditId", '', !'Id', True, '')
	WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"AuditDate", '', !'Date', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"AuditTableName", '', !'Table Name', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"AuditTableKey", '', !'Table Key', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"AuditDescription", '', !'Description', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"AuditShortDescription", '', !'Short Description', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"GAMUserGUID", '', !'GUID', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SecUserId", '', !'User Id', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"AuditAction", '', !'Action', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITID"
				&TFAuditId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFAuditId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITDATE"
				&TFAuditDate.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFAuditDate_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITTABLENAME"
				&TFAuditTableName.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITTABLENAME_SEL"
				&TFAuditTableName_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITTABLEKEY"
				&TFAuditTableKey.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFAuditTableKey_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITDESCRIPTION"
				&TFAuditDescription.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITDESCRIPTION_SEL"
				&TFAuditDescription_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITSHORTDESCRIPTION"
				&TFAuditShortDescription.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITSHORTDESCRIPTION_SEL"
				&TFAuditShortDescription_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFGAMUSERGUID"
				&TFGAMUserGUID.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFGAMUSERGUID_SEL"
				&TFGAMUserGUID_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSECUSERID"
				&TFSecUserId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFSecUserId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITACTION"
				&TFAuditAction.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITACTION_SEL"
				&TFAuditAction_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor
